sinopsis.en: Guido, a 24-year-old gay man, returns to his hometown on the outskirts of Córdoba Capital to visit his family. During dinner, he is confronted by his older siblings, Laura and Marcos, over a video circulating among their acquaintances that shows him performing in drag. Faced with this situation, his mother, Mónica, steps in to make Laura and Marcos reflect on their stance. Afterward, the siblings approach Guido and, to show their understanding, put on a homemade drag show in front of their mother.
